input: He grabbed my arm, spilled my drink and then shoved me. I didn't hit him back. She saw all of it.
draft:
Captain Doran Hale stepped toward the counter, his boots heavy against the floorboards. His gaze took in Dell Harrow's unsteady stance, the spilled liquid pooling across the wood, and Nicco standing opposite. 

"Step away from the counter, both of you," Hale said, his tone flat, calm, and practiced. He glanced toward the innkeeper. "Jessa. Are there broken bones or drawn steel?"

"Neither," Jessa Rook replied without looking up from wiping the counter edge with a dry cloth. "Just Dell making a nuisance of himself after too many cups, and a ruined drink. I was about to tell him the street has cooler air."

Hale turned his blue eyes back on Dell, his expression tightening into something stern and uncompromising. "You heard her. Step outside and walk it off before I decide this warrants a holding cell at the post." Dell grumbled, swaying on his heels, but shrank back under the guard captain's steady look and began fumbling toward the door.
